correctness.rationale: Exact projectors at eigenvalues 0, N and N-m reconstruct all entries. Rational derivative identities with strictly positive polynomial certificates give R strictly decreasing, g strictly decreasing, and |R(z)|<1 for z>0. The vertex spectral measures are first-order stochastically ordered by part size, so the smallest part has the unique first diagonal zero; N=2 is correctly exceptional. Direct exact matrix inversion checked 87 multipartite graphs and 14,925 transition entries with package-local verify.py; finite examples are corroboration only.

value.rationale: A motivated graph-family question singled out by the literature on higher diagonal Padé positivity receives a full all-step classification. The theorem proves the non-obvious persistence of every off-diagonal sign despite eventual negative diagonals, an exact dependence on the smallest independent-class size, and sharp contrast between two six-vertex multipartite networks. It is a useful analytical positivity benchmark distinct from spectral nonexpansivity and generic method-wide SSP tests.
